title: The Smile of Vessel Farm
author: I. M. Delacroix
blurb: Zephyrine Kavanagh, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
